purpose: Select exactly one assimilation value for all untouched external deployments without using any external feature, label, or outcome.
selection_predictions: leave-one-dataset-domain-out raw baseline and candidate predictions
within_domain_aggregation: mean absolute error per physical cell, then equal mean across cells
across_domain_aggregation: equal mean across the 12 dataset domains
selection_metric: domain-equal cell-macro MAE of the final prefix-causal harm-capped method
selection_rule: select the alpha with minimum selection metric; only when absolute metric differences are at most 1e-12 select the larger alpha
external_alpha_contract: The selected alpha is fixed unchanged for every structurally eligible NASA PCoE external cell. No external-domain reselection or subgroup-specific alpha is permitted.
prohibited_rescue: changing the alpha grid after inspecting selection results
using any NASA feature distribution or label for alpha selection
choosing a different alpha by NASA cell, batch, temperature, or outcome
changing the primary metric or aggregation after inspecting selection results
